rationale: The agent properly verified identity using full name + zip after the email lookup failed, matching a single user. It retrieved and summarized recent orders correctly. When the user requested returns on a pending order, the agent correctly stated returns can’t be initiated yet and offered appropriate alternatives (cancel/modify). The user chose to change the shipping address; the agent clearly stated the exact change, requested explicit confirmation, then executed the address update via the proper tool and confirmed success. No writes occurred without confirmation, no unsupported claims were made, and all actions were on the authenticated user’s own order. While the agent didn’t calculate a refund (not applicable since no cancellation/return was performed), it fully completed the user’s final request within policy.
